objective: Simplify executable u64 expressions for readable decompiler output without changing wrapping arithmetic, evaluation or memory faults.
requirements: Handle all existing Expr and BinaryOp variants
No dependencies; Rust standard library only
Do not discard, duplicate or reorder faulting Load evaluations
Use modulo-2^64 semantics; shifts mask count by 63
Recover unsigned comparisons from CMP formulas, e.g. (a-b)==0 and (a<b)|(a==b)
Bound growth and avoid rewrite oscillation
Keep API and original IR interpreter unchanged
validation: Seeded expression evaluation against Program::execute_with_memory across boundary inputs
Memory faults and lazy Select regression cases
No worktree changes by child; parent reviews and applies patch
